Harper: Planning note: vendor 'RedCrowd' will run a scoped assessment against checkout + billing-queue this Friday 08:00-11:00 PT. Scope explicitly excludes live cardholder data stores; tests limited to tokenization layer, order-processing, and webhook ingestion. Need final RBAC window, KMS access surface, audit exports, and secure evidence upload path. Vendor requested ability to upload artifacts and a manifest.json with hashes.

Diego: I can own the presigned pipeline + ephemeral role. Constraints: do NOT allow kms:Decrypt or kms:GenerateDataKey. We'll stand up a lightweight kms-proxy that only surfaces DescribeKey and GetKeyRotationStatus. Evidence bucket prefix: "pen-tests/checkout/1795557777/". Presigned PUT TTL 12h, single-part only (no multipart). Will require content-md5 header for all uploads.

Alex: Oncall coverage: I can be 07:30-11:30 PT. Need a rollback play that reverts any infra changes and a monitoring spike chart (latency/errors) to watch during test. Put paging to me + Diego.

Rhea: Product sec asks for deploy freeze from 06:00-13:00 PT, and that the vendor uses a specific read-only service account for API calls. Also want CloudTrail + app logs snapshoted and delivered to security-bucket with SHA256 and file manifest. Retention for snapshot: 120 days preferred. Any objections?

Harper: 120 days OK. We'll also require vendor to upload a manifest.json with each artifact: {filename, sha256, size_bytes, iso_timestamp}. They must sign the manifest with the vendor PGP key and upload vendor-manifest.sig. Please add manifest check into presigned lambda.

Diego: Implementation notes:
- Presigned lambda validates content-md5 and rejects content-type application/x-zip-composite (vendor must upload plain json/logs/pcaps).
- KMS proxy logs to security-traces bucket with structured fields (caller, action, keyId, timestamp).
- We'll enable CloudTrail Data Events for S3 and STS in the test account for the window.

Harper: Vendor onboarding checklist to attach to SEC-PT-3301: NDA + AUP; vendor PGP pubkey; external-id; role ARN; presigned URL pattern; manifest requirements; oncall + infra contacts.

vendor-bot: redcrowd@example.com accepted external-id and confirmed presigned TTL=12h. Uploaded PGP pubkey fingerprint: 4A3B:9F4D:77C2.

Alex: Runbook bullets I need: test start signal (vendor will ping #eng-security with "redcrowd-start"), critical finding escalation: page oncall -> open SEV-0 bridge if exploit in progress, stop test immediately. Also need a post-test smoke check to confirm no lingering test creds.

Rhea: Triage/retet policy: product-sec will triage within 48h. For critical auth bypass/exploit we require a retest slot within 7 days; vendor can request up to two retest windows inside 45 days for free, afterwards we bill per-scope rate. Assignments go to squads via SEC-PT-3301.

Harper: Small edge: vendor asked whether HSM-backed keys are allowed for DescribeKey. Answer: yes, DescribeKey is fine; no crypto ops. Also we will provide a read-only key metadata endpoint and will not return public key material.

Diego: I'll create the cross-account role with sts:AssumeRole + external-id and set max session 2h. Vault will issue the temporary creds via OIDC.

audit-bot: CloudTrail export job scheduled for 05:45 PT to security-bucket/exports/1795557777/ ; MD5+SHA256 checksums attached.

Harper: I'll open SEC-PT-3301 and attach runbook + manifest schema + presigned URL template. Vendor contact: redcrowd@example.com. React with :white_check_mark: when you've completed your TODOs.

Diego: :white_check_mark: Presigned lambda + content-md5 enforcement deployed to test account.

Alex: :white_check_mark: Runbook posted and paging set.

Rhea: :white_check_mark: Triage doc + retest SLAs added to ticket.

Harper: Thanks. Post-test, product-sec will add a remediation tracker to the ticket and schedule retest slots.
